true_answer: If we had chosen the other complex eigenvalue from this pair and its corresponding eigenvector, we would end up with the same solutions. (NOTE: to do the following example you will want to go into the CAS dialog box and check Approx and Complex and you will want flag 27 unchecked - see CTL 1). Let us consider the following example: 4. 1. Enter the matrix 1 4 1 1 and store it in F1-A 2.Recall A to the stack and press F2-EGNV. We see [(-1.,-2.) (-1.,2.)] on the stack. We will use the second eigenvalue, -1 + 2i to find the solutions, but it does not matter which one we choose.
